description.value:
Always on (automated): +1 to Craft and Mechanical checks.

Action (once per scene): spend your Action on this technique; your next Craft and Mechanical check this scene gains a further +2.

Field repair (automated): use the item on a Vehicle, Mecha, construct or device within reach to restore 1d6+1 Health; press Apply Healing on the Chat Card. It does not heal living creatures.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
